maker.name: TTC
maker.about: TTC is the switch brand of Huizhou Trantek Electronics Co., Ltd., founded in 1998 in Huizhou, which also makes mouse switches, encoders and connectors. Its keyboard line covers MX-style mechanical and Hall-effect magnetic switches.

switches.name: Horse

switches.name: Brother V2

reviews.verdict: Well-lubed click-bar switch with a softer, less aggressive click than rivals like Box Jades; batch variation and some stem wobble.

sources.title: ThereminGoat: TTC Brother V2 Switch Review

switches.notes: TTC describes a torsion-spring click with a damping leaf spring.

switches.name: Heart

reviews.verdict: Silent linear with internal dampers and light factory lube; the reviewer counts it among TTC switches that rival enthusiast mods.

switches.notes: Silent linear first used by Ducky keyboards and later sold separately by vendors such as Epomaker. Not listed on TTC's store in 2026-11.

switches.name: Neptune

reviews.verdict: Short look: very low stem wobble and well-judged factory lube make it one of the best of its alternative MX style.

sources.title: TTC: Neptune and Venus Switch-MX Style
ThereminGoat: Odd Switch Short II: TTC Venus/Neptune

switches.notes: Flattened top housing with the slider rails moved into the top housing and an LED slot.

switches.name: PT Black

reviews.verdict: Close to Cherry MX Hyperglide Blacks with a consistent scratch that hurts it stock; cheap, uniform, much better after break-in.

reviews.verdict: Smooth, well-balanced light linear with low wobble; bass-heavy stock sound and uneven top-out across the batch.

switches.notes: Sold through 2021 group buys in 42g and 55g weights; the group buys have ended.
